cases.name: apoe
cases.why: The HMM scoring help page's example, human APOE: one best hit, PTHR18976:SF2. Also the self-check

cases.name: test
cases.why: The release's own query, test.fasta: 773 models in 56 families pass the cutoff on the full library

cases.name: tie-pthr35774
cases.why: PTHR35774's family model and its one subfamily's tie (HMMSCORE-1): divergence 13 reports PTHR35774:SF1

cases.name: pir-pthr34093
cases.why: The best model is PTHR34093..pir, read as PTHR34093, whose model file holds the family's model (HMMSCORE-9)

cases.name: no-hit
cases.why: No model reported: an empty <scores>, so hit is null

cases.name: over-cutoff
cases.why: A table with a row, whose best E-value is over 1e-3: no hit (HMMSCORE-5's cutoff)

cases.name: best-over-cutoff
cases.why: The best model, by score, is over 1e-3, and a lower-scoring one is under it: no hit, as getBestHit tests the best hit alone (HMMSCORE-5)

cases.name: apoe-lower
cases.why: The example in lower case: the CGI is posted it so, the engine gets it upper-cased, as from the API

cases.name: apoe-uncommon
cases.why: The example with B, J, O, U, X and Z at residues 50, 100, 150, 200, 250 and 300

cases.name: apoe-dot
cases.why: The example with a . after residues 80, 160 and 240, which 3.1b2 and 3.4 read as positions

cases.name: apoe-underscore
cases.why: The example with a _ after residues 80, 160 and 240

cases.name: apoe-tilde
cases.why: The example with a ~ after residues 80, 160 and 240

cases.name: apoe-star
cases.why: The example with a * after residues 80, 160 and 240

cases.name: titin-10000
cases.why: The first 10,000 residues of titin, UniProt Q8WZ42: the API's residue limit (divergence 11), and the time limit's check
